text: The retry fix you made in `billing/stripe_client.py` and `tests/test_stripe_client.py` is staged. Check it before committing, including a fresh pair of eyes; the suite already had two failing timezone tests yesterday, so distinguish those from anything this patch breaks.

I’m using OpenClaw to track client work, and I need it to pull overdue tasks from our Notion database “Acme Launch” into a morning digest. Can you find a plugin for that and show me the options before installing anything?

I’m near 18th and Valencia in San Francisco and need a coffee shop to work from for the next hour. Find three places within 800 meters that are open right now and rated at least 4.3, and include their addresses and closing times.

My laptop takes 9 hours to transcribe the recordings listed in `interviews.csv` with Whisper large-v3, and Maya needs all 180 transcripts by tomorrow morning. Can you adapt `transcribe.py` so I can kick it off remotely, keep the model weights cached between runs, and stop paying for compute once the files are done?

Our support team rated 18,000 pairs of chatbot replies in `support_votes.jsonl`, and I want our Mistral 7B checkpoint to favor the replies they picked. I’ve only got one A100 40GB and can’t fit a second frozen copy of the model—can you set up a run in `experiments/support-v2` that works within that limit?
Find the email from Elena Ruiz in my Gmail about the Brighton venue deposit, and draft a reply saying we approve the £850 quote and need the invoice by Friday. Don’t send it yet.

Find the latest email from Maya Chen about the Riverside venue deposit in my work inbox, save any attachments to ~/Documents/Riverside, and reply that I’ll send the $850 payment by Friday. Then move the thread into my Events folder.

Our support bot keeps missing exact part numbers like XR-417 even when it finds similar troubleshooting articles, and `search_backend.py` currently loads all 2 million article embeddings into RAM. Can you replace that with a hosted setup that blends meaning-based matches with exact terms, keeps each customer's articles separate, and handles launch-day spikes without us babysitting servers?

I photographed my handwritten alphabet, numbers, and punctuation in /Users/maya/Desktop/lettering.jpg—can you turn it into a font called “Maya’s Hand” for my wedding place cards? I’m on a Mac and need something I can install and use in Pages.

The invoice preview and CSV export both show NaN when an order has a refunded line item; I reproduced it with order 1842 in `billing/fixtures/refunded-order.json`. Can you trace their shared calculation code and fix the underlying bug, reusing our existing money helpers and adding regression tests for both outputs?

I’ve got 18,000 support-ticket replies in `data/billing_replies.jsonl` and one RTX 4090 with 24GB VRAM; can you write a training script to adapt Mistral-7B using QLoRA? Keep the base weights frozen, save just the adapter to `outputs/billing-adapter`, and include a small inference script so Priya can test it tomorrow.

My [name withheld] 2 is connected and the desktop app is running while I work on the Q3 budget spreadsheet. Can you check my current readings against yesterday’s session and suggest whether to keep going for another 25 minutes or take a break?

Please use `notes/atlas-launch-nov7.txt` to pull together what Maya, Luis, and I agreed to, separating firm commitments from ideas we just discussed and flagging any missing owners or dates. Check our Atlas GitHub issues for overlap, then draft the proposed issue changes and a recap email for my review—don’t post or send anything yet.

I recorded a weird whine in my kitchen in `fridge_night.wav`; can you make a spectrogram of seconds 18–30, focusing on 500–8000 Hz? Save it as `fridge_whine.png` and include a loudness panel so I can see whether it lines up with the compressor kicking in.

Please order a Logitech MX Master 3S in graphite from Best Buy and ship it to my saved home address in Austin. I’m on my Mac and can approve the payment on my phone—check with me on the total before charging anything.

Priya flagged the claim in my draft `kv_cache_notes.tex` that 4-bit KV caches barely affect long-context accuracy, and I need something solid before Thursday’s lab meeting. Can you pull together three recent sources that actually test this, note their models and context lengths, and give me BibTeX plus links so I can check the results?

I’m planning to move our warehouse to weekend shipping, but only Maya, our ops lead, knows the carrier cutoff agreements and staffing constraints. Can you help me put together something she can fill out before Thursday so I can decide whether a January 18 launch is realistic?

I’m valuing Northstar Packaging for our investment committee using the attached Northstar_2023_2025.xlsx and Q3_2026_results.pdf; please build a five-year DCF in Northstar_valuation.xlsx with selectable bear, base and bull cases and sensitivity grids for WACC versus terminal growth. Keep the calculations editable, cite the inputs, and pause for my approval of the historical figures before starting forecasts, then check in at each major valuation stage.

Can you open Chrome and update the “Riverside launch” card in Trello to be due November 18, then move it to “Ready for review”? I’m editing budget.xlsx in Excel, so please leave my cursor and active window alone.
What’s the plural of “cactus”—is it “cacti” or “cactuses”?

Find the latest email from Priya Shah at priya@northstar.io in my work account about invoice NS-284, and reply that we’ll pay it on Friday with ~/Documents/NS-284-approval.pdf attached. Then move the thread to Finance and tell me which message IDs you handled.

Can you duplicate the “Vendor Intake” agent Maya shared with me and call my version “Nina’s Vendor Intake”? Keep its setup and tools, but make it private to me—I’ll connect my own Slack account afterward.

The scrape you just ran for apartment listings in Ballard got exactly what I need: address, rent, beds, and listing URL. Save that working approach as reusable browser automation so next week I can pull the same data without figuring out the site again.

Maya handed off Kanban card KB-284, run r-913, for the CSV export fix in `src/export/orders.ts`; it’s back after one rejection for dropping orders with blank customer names. Please independently check the updated behavior and tests, then close the card if it passes or send it back with specific findings; flag anything that needs my decision.

Please review `docs/plans/tenant-export.md` before Priya and I commit to it tomorrow—we’re adding CSV exports for 800 customer accounts, and I’m worried the queue design could leak data across tenants or swamp Postgres. Challenge the assumptions and check the existing code for evidence, but don’t implement anything yet.

Can you make an editable architecture diagram for our Harbor checkout service: React storefront → API gateway → Orders API, with Orders writing to Postgres and publishing to Redis for the receipt worker? Save it in ~/diagrams/harbor-checkout and send me a shareable link for Priya’s review tomorrow.

I’m launching Patchbay, a webhook monitoring tool, and need a responsive landing page in `index.html` that feels like Supabase’s site—dark surfaces, emerald highlights, and crisp technical typography. Include a sample event log, pricing at $19 and $79 a month, and a signup button; send me a live preview so I can check it on my phone.
What’s a synonym for “helpful” that sounds more professional in a performance review?

Our Python preprocessing script takes 40 minutes to chew through 6 GB of support tickets in `tickets_2026.txt`. Can you replace it with Hugging Face tokenizers, train a 32k BPE vocabulary on that file, and save `support_tokenizer.json`, keeping character offsets so Priya can map predicted entities back onto the untouched tickets?
Maya’s coming over for dinner in 20 minutes—can you set my Hue dining room bulbs to warm white at 35% and switch off the hallway lights?

Our warehouse dashboard is an old Vue app, and I want staff to type “find order 4821 and mark it packed” in a little assistant panel rather than hunt through menus. Can you wire that into `src/App.vue` using the existing page controls, with model requests routed through our `/api/llm` backend so no credentials reach the browser?

Can you look through my sent Gmail from the last six months and figure out my writing style so future email drafts sound like me? I’m Maya at Northline Studio—my notes to coworkers are pretty different from what I send clients, so please capture both and save what you learn for next time.

Every weekday at 8am Chicago time, check new Sentry issues for our checkout-web repo and draft fixes with passing tests, remembering issue IDs so nothing gets tackled twice. Hold any PRs for my approval and ping me in Slack #checkout-ops if something gets stuck; let’s try one actual issue together before setting this up to run regularly.

I need a registration page for our Cedar Loop pottery workshops before tickets open Friday: three class options, dates, prices, and a working signup form. Use the branding in `brand-guide.pdf` and the class details in `workshops.csv`, build it in our existing Next.js repo, and check that it works on phones before sending me the preview link.

The test `tests/test_invoice_merge.py::test_duplicate_credit` ends up with three credits instead of two, but the full traceback and extra logging haven’t shown where the list changes. Can you run it interactively and stop inside `merge_credits()` in `billing/invoices.py` to catch the mutation, then remove any temporary debugging changes?
I spent most of Saturday trying to make homemade pizza, and the dough stuck to literally everything. Did you have a less chaotic weekend?

Can you update page 4 of investor_deck.pdf so the headline reads “October Revenue” and correct “$1.8M” to “$2.1M” in the blue callout? Please keep the rest of the slide as is and send me the revised PDF.

Our ticket-routing prompt in `prompts/router.txt` only gets 73% accuracy on `data/labeled_tickets.jsonl`; can you use an evolutionary search to improve it, scoring exact department matches and keeping 20% of the examples hidden from candidate generation? I’ve got an OpenRouter key in `.env`, and spending up to $8 on a few hundred model calls is fine—save the best prompt and a score history.
I’m chatting here on the web and want you to search my personal Slack messages in the Cedar Labs workspace for the budget numbers Maya sent yesterday. Can you help me link my account?

On my Mac, https://api.parcelatlas.io/v1/lookup?parcel=138-22-041 returns 402 with a www-authenticate header mentioning tempo and a $0.05 charge. Can you pay for that lookup using my funded mppx account, save the result to parcel-041.json, and confirm the receipt?
I have keys but no locks, a space but no room, and an Enter that never takes you inside. What am I?
I’m catching up before our engineering sync—can you check https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff for the five most recent releases and give me their dates, links, and a quick summary of each?

I’m making a Suno track for my sister Lena’s last shift at our family diner in Duluth before she moves to Seattle; write lyrics around her chipped blue mug, the 5 a.m. coffee pot, and Dad pretending he isn’t crying. Give me a bittersweet indie-folk sound at 92 BPM, with a warm, slightly raspy female voice, a big singalong payoff, and a quiet ending, plus text for the style and exclusion boxes.

Can you turn `volunteer-onboarding.md` into a portrait infographic for the new helpers at our Eastside food pantry? Make the six arrival-to-cleanup steps easy to follow, with friendly pastel illustrations, and keep the shift times and safety reminders exactly as written.

Our Node service hangs about one in five runs of `tests/invoice-sync.test.ts`, right after `flushBatch()` in `src/billing/sync.ts`. Can you reproduce it and step through the stuck run to check the pending promises and local queue state, rather than adding more logging?
Can you upload `november-renewals.csv` to our new Airtable base? My Airtable token isn’t stored with you yet—send me a secure link so I can provide it.

Our invoice importer in `billing/extract.py` keeps breaking on malformed JSON from Claude when processing PDFs from Westbridge Supplies. Can you switch it to return Pydantic objects with invoice number, vendor, line items, and totals, reject negative quantities, and retry twice with validation feedback before logging a failed invoice?
Is “accommodate” spelled correctly?
What does “taciturn” mean, and can you use it in a sentence?

I’ve attached diner_front.jpg from our café in Tacoma—can you make it look like a scene on the old Nintendo I had as a kid? It’s for our anniversary post; a 5-second looping GIF with rain and a gently flickering neon sign would be great.
